verses.original: Τὸ λοιπὸν προσεύχεσθε ἀδελφοί περὶ ἡμῶν ἵνα ὁ λόγος τοῦ Κυρίου τρέχῃ καὶ δοξάζηται καθὼς καὶ πρὸς ὑμᾶς
verses.transliteration: To loipon proseuchesthe adelphoi peri hēmōn hina ho logos tou Kyriou trechē kai doxazētai kathōs kai pros hymas
verses.literal: Finally brothers pray for us that the word of the Lord may spread quickly and be held in honor just as it was with you

verses.original: καὶ ἵνα ῥυσθῶμεν ἀπὸ τῶν ἀτόπων καὶ πονηρῶν ἀνθρώπων οὐ γὰρ πάντων ἡ πίστις
verses.transliteration: kai hina rhysthōmen apo tōn atopōn kai ponērōn anthrōpōn ou gar pantōn hē pistis
verses.literal: And pray that we may be delivered from wicked and evil men for not everyone holds to the faith

verses.original: Πιστὸς δέ ἐστιν ὁ Κύριος ὃς στηρίξει ὑμᾶς καὶ φυλάξει ἀπὸ τοῦ πονηροῦ
verses.transliteration: Pistos de estin ho Kyrios hos stērixei hymas kai phylaxei apo tou ponērou
verses.literal: But the Lord is faithful and He will strengthen you and guard you from the evil one

verses.original: πεποίθαμεν δὲ ἐν Κυρίῳ ἐφ’ ὑμᾶς ὅτι ἃ παραγγέλλομεν καὶ ποιεῖτε καὶ ποιήσετε
verses.transliteration: pepoithamen de en Kyriō eph’ hymas hoti ha parangellomen kai poieite kai poiēsete
verses.literal: And we have confidence in the Lord - that you are doing and will continue to do what we command

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ Κύριος κατευθύναι ὑμῶν τὰς καρδίας εἰς τὴν ἀγάπην τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ εἰς τὴν ὑπομονὴν τοῦ Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: HO de Kyrios kateuthynai hymōn tas kardias eis tēn agapēn tou Theou kai eis tēn hypomonēn tou Christou
verses.literal: May the Lord direct your hearts into God’s love and - Christ’s perseverance

verses.original: Παραγγέλλομεν δὲ ὑμῖν ἀδελφοί ἐν ὀνόματι τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ στέλλεσθαι ὑμᾶς ἀπὸ παντὸς ἀδελφοῦ ἀτάκτως περιπατοῦντος καὶ μὴ κατὰ τὴν παράδοσιν ἣν παρελάβοσαν παρ’ ἡμῶν
verses.transliteration: Parangellomen de hymin adelphoi en onomati tou Kyriou hēmōn Iēsou Christou stellesthai hymas apo pantos adelphou ataktōs peripatountos kai mē kata tēn paradosin hēn parelabosan par’ hēmōn
verses.literal: Now we command you brothers in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ to keep away from any brother who leads an undisciplined life that is not in keeping with the tradition you received from us

verses.original: αὐτοὶ γὰρ οἴδατε πῶς δεῖ μιμεῖσθαι ἡμᾶς ὅτι οὐκ ἠτακτήσαμεν ἐν ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: autoi gar oidate pōs dei mimeisthai hēmas hoti ouk ētaktēsamen en hymin
verses.literal: For you yourselves know how you ought to imitate us because we were not undisciplined among you

verses.original: οὐδὲ δωρεὰν ἄρτον ἐφάγομεν παρά τινος ἀλλ’ ἐν κόπῳ καὶ μόχθῳ νυκτὸς καὶ ἡμέρας ἐργαζόμενοι πρὸς τὸ μὴ ἐπιβαρῆσαί τινα ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: oude dōrean arton ephagomen para tinos all’ en kopō kai mochthō nyktos kai hēmeras ergazomenoi pros to mē epibarēsai tina hymōn
verses.literal: nor did we eat anyone’s food without paying for it Instead in labor and toil we worked night and day so that we would not be a burden to any of you

verses.original: οὐχ ὅτι οὐκ ἔχομεν ἐξουσίαν ἀλλ’ ἵνα ἑαυτοὺς τύπον δῶμεν ὑμῖν εἰς τὸ μιμεῖσθαι ἡμᾶς
verses.transliteration: ouch hoti ouk echomen exousian all’ hina heautous typon dōmen hymin eis to mimeisthai hēmas
verses.literal: Not that we lack this right but we wanted to offer ourselves as an example for you to imitate

verses.original: καὶ γὰρ ὅτε ἦμεν πρὸς ὑμᾶς τοῦτο παρηγγέλλομεν ὑμῖν ὅτι Εἴ τις οὐ θέλει ἐργάζεσθαι μηδὲ ἐσθιέτω
verses.transliteration: kai gar hote ēmen pros hymas touto parēngellomen hymin hoti Ei tis ou thelei ergazesthai mēde esthietō
verses.literal: For even while we were with you we gave you this command . . . . . . If anyone is unwilling to work he shall not eat

verses.original: Ἀκούομεν γάρ τινας περιπατοῦντας ἐν ὑμῖν ἀτάκτως μηδὲν ἐργαζομένους ἀλλὰ περιεργαζομένους
verses.transliteration: Akouomen gar tinas peripatountas en hymin ataktōs mēden ergazomenous alla periergazomenous
verses.literal: For we hear that some of you are leading undisciplined lives accomplishing nothing but being busybodies

verses.original: τοῖς δὲ τοιούτοις παραγγέλλομεν καὶ παρακαλοῦμεν ἐν Κυρίῳ Ἰησοῦ Χριστῷ ἵνα μετὰ ἡσυχίας ἐργαζόμενοι τὸν ἑαυτῶν ἄρτον ἐσθίωσιν
verses.transliteration: tois de toioutois parangellomen kai parakaloumen en Kyriō Iēsou Christō hina meta hēsychias ergazomenoi ton heautōn arton esthiōsin
verses.literal: We command and urge such people by our Lord Jesus Christ to begin working quietly to earn their own living . . . . . . . . .

verses.original: Ὑμεῖς δέ ἀδελφοί μὴ ἐγκακήσητε καλοποιοῦντες
verses.transliteration: Hymeis de adelphoi mē enkakēsēte kalopoiountes
verses.literal: But as for you brothers do not grow weary in well-doing

verses.original: Εἰ δέ τις οὐχ ὑπακούει τῷ λόγῳ ἡμῶν διὰ τῆς ἐπιστολῆς τοῦτον σημειοῦσθε μὴ συναναμίγνυσθαι αὐτῷ ἵνα ἐντραπῇ
verses.transliteration: Ei de tis ouch hypakouei tō logō hēmōn dia tēs epistolēs touton sēmeiousthe mē synanamignysthai autō hina entrapē
verses.literal: Take note of anyone who does not obey the instructions we have given . . . in this letter Do not associate with him so that he may be ashamed

verses.original: καὶ μὴ ὡς ἐχθρὸν ἡγεῖσθε ἀλλὰ νουθετεῖτε ὡς ἀδελφόν
verses.transliteration: kai mē hōs echthron hēgeisthe alla noutheteite hōs adelphon
verses.literal: Yet do not regard him as an enemy but admonish him as a brother

verses.original: Αὐτὸς δὲ ὁ Κύριος τῆς εἰρήνης δῴη ὑμῖν τὴν εἰρήνην διὰ παντὸς ἐν παντὶ τρόπῳ ὁ Κύριος μετὰ πάντων ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: Autos de ho Kyrios tēs eirēnēs dōē hymin tēn eirēnēn dia pantos en panti tropō ho Kyrios meta pantōn hymōn
verses.literal: Now may the Lord of peace Himself give you peace at all times and in every way The Lord be with all of you

verses.original: Ὁ ἀσπασμὸς τῇ ἐμῇ χειρὶ Παύλου ὅ ἐστιν σημεῖον ἐν πάσῃ ἐπιστολῇ οὕτως γράφω
verses.transliteration: Ho aspasmos tē emē cheiri Paulou ho estin sēmeion en pasē epistolē houtōs graphō
verses.literal: This greeting is in my own hand Paul This is my mark in every letter it is the way I write

verses.original: Ἡ χάρις τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ μετὰ πάντων ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: Hē charis tou Kyriou hēmōn Iēsou Christou meta pantōn hymōn
verses.literal: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with all of you
